title: fix(plugin-report): a dataset report never draws a new selection over the previous selection's rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoUtGL5GAg1mNLn7qrQjWsWG)_

Fixes #38008
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：在报表上打开「和上一期对比」时，图表不再先闪出一帧「有对比系列、却没有对比数值」的空对比，而是先显示加载中，再画出两期数据。
- 为什么做：报表环比的这个测试偶发失败，把一个无关的 PR 踢出了合并队列；查下来根源在渲染器，用户也能看到那一帧。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是报表在切换选择时多显示一下加载中，数据本身不受影响；直接撤回这次改动即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`useDatasetRows` (the hook behind a dataset report's table, matrix and embedded chart) now records the selection signature each outcome answers, and while the current signature differs it answers `{ status: 'loading', rows: [] }` instead of the previous selection's outcome.

Why: the render that carries a new selection runs before the query effect can set loading, so `state` still held the previous selection's rows. `DatasetReportChart` computes its series from the `compareTo` prop but its rows from that state, so turning 「Compare with previous period」 on committed one render with the comparison series over rows that have no `amount__compare` value, a frame a browser can paint before "Loading chart…". The flaky test read exactly that render's props when the compare query was slower than `waitFor`'s first check.

Unchanged: a re-read of the same selection (data invalidation, same signature) still keeps its rows on screen until the answer lands; the first mount's `idle` carries no signature and is returned as before.

## Tests

- The existing case keeps line 159's assertion as written; no assertion loosened, no timeout raised.
- New case `never draws the comparison series over rows the earlier window was not queried for`: records every chart render and asserts that each render carrying a `comparison` series has `amount__compare` on every row. It is deterministic: it reds without the guard even with no delay.
- Ablation (guard removed by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, compare query delayed 50 ms by a held mutation of the test's source double; both restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| Leg | Guard | 50 ms delay | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | on | yes | 18/18 pass |
| B | off | no | new pin red (`expected { stage: 'Won', amount: 30 } to have property "amount__compare"`), 17 pass |
| C | off | yes | both red: new pin, and line 159 with the card's signature `expected { stage: 'Won', amount: 30 } to match object { amount: 30, amount__compare: 20 }`; 16 pass |

The first ablation attempt's delay leg was a no-op (the replacement contained its own anchor and the tool refused and restored); it was re-run with a corrected anchor and the table above is from that run.

## Acceptance notes

- By the code path, the same stale render runs on any change of a dataset report's selection (a period pick, for example); there it redraws rows that were already on screen. Only the comparison switch was measured (the probe log and leg B above); the guard covers every caller of the hook.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report run type-check` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 38 derived families, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, every line carries its exit code).
